APPROVE
The extraction moves the loops verbatim into three helpers, so behaviour is unchanged, and `InScript` drops from 26 to roughly 5 because the extracted loops carried about 21 points. One caveat: the source isn't on this machine, so I couldn't check that the helper parameter types (`Func<Family, bool>`, `IReadOnlyDictionary<string, bool>`, `IReadOnlySet<string>`) match what `GuardBindings`, `Known` and `InStyleSheet` actually use. Run a build before merging to confirm.
